worldModelUpdates: Existence belongs to responsibilities and independently consumed invariants, not to the apparatus that once discovered them.
Historical evidence retention and current executability are separate responsibilities; Git can own exact recoverability while current tree carries only live utilities/closeouts.
A shared package is molecular, not indivisible: current consumers justify individual profiles/modules, not the package name.
A global research method must add incremental decision value beyond a task-local frozen contract; the current method did not.
Green structural/integrity checkers do not imply semantic correctness; five independent semantic authority mutants survived the current checkers.
Generated/current projections must derive from a canonical current-state source or clearly disclaim current authority; manual status prose drifted.
The null action is a first-class success state. No feature or research phase has existence entitlement merely because the system can continue experimenting.
